ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.537

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public housing law and the administrative code of the city
of New York, in relation to establishing the New York city public housing
preservation trust for properties owned or operated by the New York city
housing authority and providing for the issuance of certain bonds, notes or
other obligations of the New York city housing development corporation
items.lawCode: Add Art 14 §§600 - 625, Pub Hous L; amd §§13-101 & 13-133, NYC Ad Cd
